{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Duplicate patient_id counts:", df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False).sum())
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))

# Identify the highest sample_seq per patient to keep only the latest
latest_per_patient = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that we now have one row per patient
print("After deduplication, number of rows:", len(latest_per_patient))

# Now compute response rate per site
counts = latest_per_patient.groupby('site')['responded'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
counts['response_rate'] = counts['sum'] / counts['count']

# Sort by response rate descending
response_rates = counts['response_rate'].sort_values(ascending=False)

# Print results
response_rates"}
